resources.name: CP2K

access.notes: Open-source electronic structure and molecular dynamics software, capable of periodic Hartree-Fock calculations.

resources.notes: Primary computational tool for geometry optimization and electronic structure.

resources.name: Basis sets (6‑31G* for C,N,Na; modified 6‑31G* for K)

access.notes: Standard 6‑31G* for C, N, Na; modified 6‑31G* for K from Ricart et al. (1995). Obtainable via Basis Set Exchange or from the original publication.

resources.notes: Required basis sets for all atom types.

resources.name: Cubic TCNE crystal structure

access.notes: Experimental structure from neutron diffraction: space group Im3 (No. 204), a = 9.736 Å, three mutually perpendicular TCNE molecules per primitive cell. Molecular internal coordinates (bond lengths, angles) as given in Table 1 of the paper. The original crystal structure determination is published: Little et al. (1971); the data can also be found in the ICSD/CCDC.

resources.notes: Starting point for all crystal optimizations.
